method: All 49 player pages inspected at desktop and phone widths. Base captures sample top, middle and end; follow-ups cover new Structures content and source corrections. Native preview frame screenshots in base/follow-up phases are prior references; native-frame and final-details phases verify corrected 23x15 geometry and unclipped HUDs. Each of the 48 base contact sheets and 11 follow-up sheets was visually inspected, with targeted full-size images for suspected defects. This does not exhaust every engine interaction or horizontal cell of every catalog table.
